question: **Saint Kabir believed that saintly people: **

options.text: can be overcome by fear easily
are not willing to suffer a hundred times

solution:
The correct answer is: **can regain their strength easily**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **fifth sentence of the first paragraph** in the given passage states that- *"Saint Kabir described how different people respond when challenged by problems: “Gold, virtuous people and saints are resilient; you may break them a hundred times and yet they will rejoin.__"*
 
• That means **"Saints are strong; you can break them 100 times, and they will always mend."**

From here we can conclude that **option 1** is the right answer.
